# R7 evals — Symmetry and movement on every app screen

> Base for every diff is `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md)` (resolved at run time, never pasted). Run from the worktree root under bash or zsh. Written from spec R7.1 to R7.6, not from builder code. No database, no paid API, localhost only. Do not print `.env*`.
>
> Playwright always: `KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts ...`.
> Every "no line before `X-done`" check: PASS only if nothing prints before the `...X-done` marker (lines the check says are informational excepted).
> If a cmd prints `NO-BASE`, the eval file is not committed yet: FAIL until it is.

R7-01. Scope: changed plus untracked paths are only R7.1 files or tests — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; { git diff --name-only "$B"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep . | grep -vE '^(e2e/real-[a-z-]+\.(spec\.)?ts|src/styles/app-theme\.css|src/components/(ui/.*|shell/.*|cover-real/.*|covers/.*|chat/HospitalsView\.tsx|public/(SignIn\.tsx|signin\.module\.css)|access/AccessCard(\.tsx|\.module\.css))|tests/.*|docs/build/(spec|evals)/R7\.md|docs/build/evals/R7-baseline\.txt)$'; echo "scope X-done"` — expect: no line before `scope X-done` — PASS if every changed or untracked path is in the allowed set.

R7-02. Not-edited files unchanged — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; { git diff --name-only "$B"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -E '(^|/)(Landing\.tsx|landing\.module\.css|Tour\.tsx|package\.json|package-lock\.json)$|^src/styles/tokens\.css$|^src/app/globals\.css$|^src/adapters/|^src/app/api/|^src/app/\(app\)/emergency/'; echo "unchanged X-done"` — expect: no line before `unchanged X-done` — PASS if none of the not-edited paths changed or gained an untracked file.

R7-03. Typecheck and lint — cmd: `npm run typecheck > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-tc.txt" 2>&1; echo "typecheck rc=$?"; npm run lint > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-lint.txt" 2>&1; echo "lint rc=$?"; grep -E '^/|^[^ ]+\.(ts|tsx|css|js|mjs)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-lint.txt" | grep -v 'src/app/layout.tsx'; grep -E '[0-9]+ errors?' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-lint.txt"; echo "lint X-done"` — expect: `typecheck rc=0`, `lint rc=0`, no other file path and no `N errors` line with N above 0 before `lint X-done` — PASS if all hold (the one `src/app/layout.tsx` warning is allowed).

R7-04. Harness exports and `settle` call order — cmd: `F=e2e/real-calm.ts; for n in expectAligned expectMoves settle; do grep -qE "^export (async )?(const|function) $n([^A-Za-z0-9_]|\$)" $F || echo "MISSING export $n"; done; for n in expectCalm expectNothingCutOff; do awk -v n="$n" 'BEGIN{p="^export (async )?(const|function) " n "([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)"} $0 ~ p {f=1; b=$0; next} f && /^export /{exit} f{b=b "\n" $0} END{s=index(b,"settle("); m=index(b,"measure("); if(f!=1) print "NO DECL " n; else if(s==0) print "NO settle in " n; else if(m>0 && m<s) print "settle after measure in " n}' $F; done; echo "calm X-done"` — expect: no line before `calm X-done` — PASS if the three new exports exist and both `expectCalm` and `expectNothingCutOff` bodies call `settle(` before their first `measure(`.

R7-05. No existing rule loosened — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; git diff "$B" -- e2e/real-calm.ts | grep -E '^-' | grep -vE '^---' | sed 's/^/REMOVED: /'; git diff "$B" -- e2e/real-calm.ts | grep -E '^-' | grep -vE '^---' | grep -vE '^-export const (expectCalm|expectNothingCutOff)[^A-Za-z0-9_]' | sed 's/^/UNEXPECTED: /'; echo "loosen X-done"` — expect: no `UNEXPECTED:` line; `REMOVED:` lines are informational and listed for the reviewer — PASS if every line removed from the base file is a declaration line of `expectCalm` or `expectNothingCutOff`; any other removed line (a threshold, tolerance, selector or rule body) is FAIL unless the reviewer confirms in writing it is a pure re-format with identical values.

R7-06. Motion layer in `app-theme.css` — cmd: `F=src/styles/app-theme.css; test -f $F || echo "NO CSS"; echo "keyframes=[$(grep -oE '@keyframes +[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' $F | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')]"; grep -qE -- '--ctl-h *: *52px' $F || echo "MISSING --ctl-h 52px"; grep -qF '@media (max-height: 760px)' $F || echo "MISSING 760 block"; grep -qF 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' $F || echo "MISSING reduced-motion block"; grep -qF 'kv-rise' $F || echo "MISSING kv-rise"; echo "theme X-done"` — expect: `keyframes=[kv-fade kv-rise ]`, no `MISSING` or `NO CSS` line before `theme X-done` — PASS if the keyframe set is exactly `kv-fade` and `kv-rise`, `--ctl-h` is 52px, the 760px max-height block and the reduced-motion block exist.

R7-07. No module defines keyframes — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; while IFS= read -r f; do n=$(grep -c '@keyframes' "$f"); b=$(git show "${B}:${f}" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '@keyframes'); if [ "$n" -gt "$b" ]; then echo "NEW keyframes in $f now=$n base=$b"; fi; done < <(git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -- src/components | grep -E '\.(css|tsx)$'); echo "kf X-done"` — expect: no line before `kf X-done` — PASS if no file under `src/components` has more `@keyframes` than at base (files that already had one are allowed at the same count).

R7-08. Every `data-free` is explained — cmd: `grep -rlF --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' --include='*.css' 'data-free' src | while IFS= read -r f; do awk -v f="$f" 'FNR==1{prev=""} /data-free/ { if ($0 !~ /(\/\/|\/\*|\*\/)/ && prev !~ /(\/\/|\/\*|\*\/)/) print f ":" FNR ": " $0 } {prev=$0}' "$f"; done; echo "free X-done"` — expect: no line before `free X-done` — PASS if every `data-free` line in `src` has a comment marker (`//`, `/*`, `*/`) on the same or the previous line.

R7-09. Align spec shape — cmd: `node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f=process.argv[1];if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.log("NO FILE "+f);process.exit(0)}const s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const t=[...s.matchAll(/\btest\(\s*(["`'"'"'])((?:\\.|(?!\1).)*)\1/g)].map(m=>m[2]);const w=["a tab, a pager and a switch each animate their new content","moving between pages animates the new page","reduced motion keeps fades and drops transforms"];const p=[];if(t.length<12)p.push("only "+t.length+" tests, need >= 12 (3 named plus one per screen)");for(const x of w)if(!t.includes(x))p.push("missing title: "+x);for(const k of ["opening|landing|start","home","my policies","compare","stress","hospital","wizard|step","pay","guidance"])if(!new RegExp(k,"i").test(s))p.push("no screen keyword: "+k);for(const r of ["expectCalm","expectAligned","expectMoves"])if(!s.includes(r+"("))p.push("never calls "+r);if(!(/1440/.test(s)&&/1366/.test(s))&&!/SIZES/.test(s))p.push("no 1440 and 1366 sizes");if(/\b(test|it|describe)\.(skip|only|fixme|todo)\b/.test(s))p.push("skip or only found");console.log("count="+t.length,"problems="+p.length);p.forEach(x=>console.log("PROBLEM: "+x))' e2e/real-align.spec.ts; echo "spec X-done"` — expect: `problems=0`, no `PROBLEM:` or `NO FILE` line — PASS if the file exists with at least 12 tests, the three R7.5 titles exactly, a keyword for every R7.5 screen group, all three rule helpers called, both laptop sizes (or `SIZES`) used and no skip or only.

R7-10. Baseline report names the four known defects — cmd: `F=docs/build/evals/R7-baseline.txt; test -s $F || echo "NO BASELINE"; echo "finding-lines=$(grep -c 'finding:' $F)"; grep -qiE 'search' $F && grep -qiE 'button|shorter|height' $F || echo "MISSING search field vs button"; grep -qiE 'pager' $F || echo "MISSING pager"; grep -qiE 'source' $F || echo "MISSING source cells"; grep -qiE 'rail' $F && grep -qiE 'ask ?bar|ask-bar' $F || echo "MISSING rail vs ask bar"; echo "baseline X-done"` — expect: `finding-lines=` at least 4, no `NO BASELINE` or `MISSING` line before `baseline X-done` — PASS if the file exists, has at least four `finding:` lines and names the policy search field shorter than its button, the centred pager, the two-line right-aligned source cells and the rail and ask bar bottoms on Home.

R7-11. Existing unit titles kept, no test file deleted — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; for f in $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M "$B" -- tests | grep -E '\.test\.tsx?$'); do git show "${B}:${f}" > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-base-test.txt"; node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const re=/\b(?:it|test)\(\s*(["`'"'"'])((?:\\.|(?!\1).)*)\1/g;const ti=p=>[...fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8").matchAll(re)].map(m=>m[2]);const b=ti(process.argv[1]),n=ti(process.argv[2]);const lost=b.filter(x=>!n.includes(x));console.log(process.argv[2]+" base="+b.length+" now="+n.length+" lost="+JSON.stringify(lost))' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-base-test.txt" "$f"; done; git diff --name-status --diff-filter=D "$B" -- tests; echo "titles X-done"` — expect: every printed line ends `lost=[]` with now >= base, no deleted-file line before `titles X-done` (no lines at all is fine when no test file changed) — PASS if no base title is lost and no test file is deleted.

R7-12. Whole unit suite passes, no skip added — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; npx vitest run > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-vitest.txt" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -E '^\s*(Test Files|Tests) ' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-vitest.txt"; git diff "$B" -- tests e2e | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+\+\+' | grep -E '(it|test|describe)\.(skip|only|todo|fixme)|xit\(|xdescribe\('; echo "suite X-done"` — expect: `rc=0`, `Test Files` and `Tests` lines with no `failed` and no `skipped`, nothing else before `suite X-done` — PASS if rc=0, no failed or skipped count and no added skip, only, todo or fixme.

R7-13. Decisive: align spec passes with zero findings — cmd: `O="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-pw-align.txt"; KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts e2e/real-align.spec.ts --reporter=list > "$O" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -E '^\s*[0-9]+ (passed|failed|skipped|flaky|did not run)' "$O"; echo "finding-count=$(grep -c 'finding:' "$O")"; for t in 'a tab, a pager and a switch each animate their new content' 'moving between pages animates the new page' 'reduced motion keeps fades and drops transforms'; do grep -qF -- "$t" "$O" || echo "NOT RUN: $t"; done; echo "align X-done"` — expect: `rc=0`, exactly one summary line `N passed` with N at least 12, `finding-count=0`, no `NOT RUN` line — PASS if all hold. Any measured-rule finding on any screen at 1440x900 or 1366x650 is FAIL (this task owns the fix).

R7-14. Decisive: full real suite passes, zero findings, port free — cmd: `O="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r7-pw-all.txt"; KV_E2E_PORT=3312 npx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts > "$O" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -E '^\s*[0-9]+ (passed|failed|skipped|flaky|did not run)' "$O"; echo "finding-count=$(grep -c 'finding:' "$O")"; lsof -nP -iTCP:3312 -sTCP:LISTEN; echo "port X-done"` — expect: `rc=0`, exactly one summary line `N passed` with N at least 33 (30 before R7 plus the 3 named R7 tests), no failed, skipped, flaky or did-not-run line, `finding-count=0`, no `lsof` row before `port X-done` — PASS if all hold. Because the rules now run in every spec through `expectCalm`, a finding in an older spec is FAIL too.

R7-15. No hex, shadow, gradient or blur added in CSS — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; git diff "$B" -- '*.css' | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+\+\+' | grep -E '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}([^0-9a-fA-F]|$)|box-shadow|gradient|backdrop-filter|blur\(' | grep -vE 'box-shadow: *none'; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- '*.css' | while IFS= read -r f; do grep -nE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}([^0-9a-fA-F]|$)|box-shadow|gradient|backdrop-filter|blur\(' "$f" | grep -vE 'box-shadow: *none' | sed "s|^|$f: |"; done; echo "css X-done"` — expect: no line before `css X-done` — PASS if no added CSS line (tracked diff or new CSS file) holds a hex colour, a box-shadow other than `none`, a gradient, backdrop-filter or blur.

R7-16. No secret or `.env` path added — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R7.md); test -n "$B" || echo "NO-BASE"; git diff "$B" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+\+\+' | grep -iE 'secret|password|api_key|bearer [a-z0-9]'; { git diff --name-only "$B"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | grep -E '(^|/)\.env'; echo "secret X-done"` — expect: no line before `secret X-done` — PASS if no added line holds those words and no changed or untracked path is an `.env*` file.
